shared_elements: relief carving on a single stone surface
circular or disc-shaped motif (chest disc / rosette-like clusters)
incised linear detailing of garment or body ornament
justification: Both are tall stone surfaces bearing a single dominant anthropomorphic figure rendered in low relief with incised ornamental detail, and both include prominent rounded/disc motifs. But A is a massive three-dimensional boulder with a frontal, blocky, heavily eroded figure whose forms are broad and shallow, while B is a flat rectangular panel with a crisply incised profile figure, wing, handled bucket and stylised vegetation — a wholly different manner of drawing and a different compositional logic.
